title: Fix retrigger form config sync
body:
Fixes the `Trigger again with this config` flow so edits made in `Run Parameters` stay synchronized with the JSON shown in `Advanced Options` and the config used on submit.

The root cause was that the prefilled re-trigger path initialized correctly, but later `conf` updates were not propagated back into the React Hook Form state after prefill had already been applied. This change keeps the initial prefill behavior and restores ongoing sync afterward. It also adds a regression test covering the prefilled re-trigger case.

Related: #65716
